_comment: Authoritative idea pipeline. matrix.md is generated from this. Stages: captured -> researching -> validated -> committed | parked | killed. Every idea has a kill_by date at capture.

ideas.title: Climate Radar — weekly digest of climate/ops companies shipping AI features (prospecting signal for the practice)
ideas.notes: Scratches the practice's own itch: warm-path prospecting beats cold lists, and funding/launch announcements are the trigger events. Market score low: news-digest tools are a graveyard. Real question is whether the warm-path overlay (who do we know there) is differentiated. Strategy gate applies: validate only; the practice is services this year.

ideas.title: Post-mortem kit for AI feature launches (templates + facilitation guide)
ideas.notes: Sparked by the Acme engagement prep. Might be content (free posts) rather than product — classify honestly before scoring.

ideas.title: Proposal teardown newsletter for solo consultants
ideas.kill_reason: Crowded (4 established consulting-content plays found in the scan), and it productizes the least differentiated part of the practice. Post-mortem: the idea was procrastination dressed as leverage — spend the energy writing better proposals, not writing about them.
